findings.evidence: POWER_ECLIPSE has native minimum -100 and the Druid Eclipse implementation uses negative power for Lunar; >= -70 correctly rejects non-lunar/<=70 energy while permitting native power below -70.
The existing balance_neutral_opener rejection remains before the new balance_starfall_lunar_window predicate, preserving the neutral exception and its typed reason.
The new predicate reads aura and Eclipse power only; there are no state writes, cooldown/stat changes, or blanket priority changes, and BotWorldPopulationMgrCombatResolver.cpp is unchanged.
The migration is restricted to Balance Druid DPS, enabled Starfall 48505, and uses an idempotent FIND_IN_SET guard.
Tests cover ordering, threshold, scope, and idempotence; source is 704 lines, test is 69 lines, and SQL is 21 lines.

evidence_limit: The pinned APL also has a later currentLunarEnergy >= 100 branch; this patch intentionally does not add timestamp/phase logic. Candidate mask, Eclipse-power timestamps, native exact-300 behavior, actor performance, and raid acceptance remain pending.
recommendation: Proceed to the coordinator-owned host12 build and reviewed SQL/runtime validation gates; do not claim actor, exact-300, or raid acceptance from this review.
